intro: Hi, I’m Ben. I tutor maths one-to-one, online, for students working towards IGCSE, GCSE, A-level, International A-level or the TMUA. I enjoy helping students build confidence as well as technique.
rates: GCSE and IGCSE: £30 per one-hour session
A-level and International A-level: £35 per one-hour session
contactNote: Drop me an email with a little about what you are working on: the level, the subjects and any exam dates. I will get back to you as soon as I can.
dbs: I am enhanced DBS checked, and this can be requested.

references.quote: I was looking for a Maths tutor particularly to teach statistics for my daughter studying for her year 2 A Levels. I came across Ben's profile and liked it so decided to go for a trial lesson. My daughter had already tried a few tutors online but didn't feel that warmth unlike the feeling she got from Ben. She liked Ben's style of teaching as he could gauge what her strengths and weaknesses were and then was able to work on them. Ben always encouraged my daughter when he saw she was struggling. Ben was also able to assist with pure maths too which was great. All in all, my daughter felt comfortable during classes and enjoyed Ben's teaching style. Thanks Ben for all your help.

After looking around and trying a few different online tutors, we were very fortunate to find Ben. My daughter needed support with maths and was understandably hesitant about trying another tutor. However, after just one lesson with Ben, she felt completely at ease and was genuinely excited to continue. From the very beginning, Ben was warm, patient, and encouraging. My daughter was not only struggling with understanding maths but was also carrying a great deal of anxiety after years of finding the subject difficult at school. Over the course of 8-9 months, he helped her develop a strong understanding of maths while gently rebuilding her confidence. What stands out most is how he transformed her relationship with the subject. The anxiety that once surrounded maths gradually disappeared. Ben has a wonderful ability to explain things in a way that truly makes sense. He is knowledgeable, thoughtful, and endlessly patient. I would wholeheartedly recommend Ben to anyone looking for an online maths tutor.
My son likes Ben's lessons, because he is very interactive and he explains topics well as they go through them, at a speed that suits his learning.

Excellent tutor, friendly and flexible, reliable and professional. He explains all material in an easy way and is helping my daughter improve her confidence in maths. We appreciate him a lot and highly recommend him!
My boy loves his sessions. He is very patient with kids and very knowledgeable. Definitely I will book him again.
